title: Krazy Ivan
overview:
Earth is under attack by robotic alien invaders, and Russian soldier Ivan Popovich is sent to stop them at the controls of a giant mechanical battle suit.

Krazy Ivan is a first-person shooter played from inside the cockpit. Stride across battlefields in five zones - Russia, Saudi Arabia, France, the United States and Japan - lock on to huge enemy war machines and blast them apart. Collect power cores from the fight and spend them between zones on upgrades and new weapons for your suit. Live-action video scenes introduce the story and play between levels.
